summary: A generative ambient firmware that plays itself from power-on: pad voices, bells on uneven tape loops, a gliding bass and soft Euclidean percussion. You shape it by choosing a piece and scale rather than performing.
features: Keys add or remove notes from the scale the music uses
Eight pieces, each saved with its own knobs, scale and tempo
Tape echo, long tape loop and plate reverb on the output
Freeze, rest and next-chord controls on PLAY, REC and EDIT
Follows MIDI clock; sends pad, bells, bass and pulse on four channels
Browser emulator to try it without an FM-1
